title: Pampanga pet crematorium closed for lack of business permit

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — The City of San Fernando’s Inter-Agency Lawful Business Operations Coordination Task Force (IALBOCTF) shut down an animal crematorium in Barangay Panipuan for lack of a business permit. In a statement on Thursday evening, the San Fernando City Hall said its IALBOCTF inspected the Holistic Animal Doctor Crematorium on November 3. While the animal crematorium’s management showed a permit to operate from the Environmental Management Bureau, it did not have a business permit from the city government.
